text:
Alex: noticing higher than usual pod restarts in us-west-2b, looks correlated with NAT egress errors from the gpu-subnet.
Priya: saw that too, packet drops + retries are spiking on metrics -> 5xxs for a subset of model-serving pods.
Josh: is this the same noisy neighbor issue from last month or new?
Alex: new pattern — egress bandwidth saturation on a handful of nodes, and kubelet OOM eviction on some GPU nodes after libcuda update yesterday.
Marie: oh — we rolled kernel+drivers on the pool last night. Could be memory leak + higher TCP retransmits.
Samira: quick ask: should we taint the affected nodes and drain to avoid more preempts?
Alex: yes, plan: 1) identify nodes with >10% egress errors, 2) cordon + drain gracefully (no disruption to critical routes), 3) shift traffic weight to other AZs and Dedicated pools.
Priya: I'll run the node query now: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-usw2b -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.status.conditions[*].type}:{.status.conditions[*].status}
'`
Josh: also add a filter on hostNetwork pods — some infra proxies are showing long tails.
infra-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-042, severity: P2 — started collecting logs and core dumps.
Samira: after draining, we should reduce batch sizes for in-flight heavy models to avoid transient OOM. Can ops-bot flip a feature flag?
deploy-bot: canary toggle `rlm.batch_size_override` set to 0.75 for production routes.
Marie: rolling back driver update on standby nodes is risky; prefer temporary traffic shift first.
Alex: agreed. Step sequence: (A) mark nodes, (B) drain noncritical pods, (C) adjust LB weights (us-west-2a + 2c + dedicated), (D) throttle client-level batch size, (E) open ticket with cloud net ops.
Priya: running `kubectl drain gpu-node-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` on target node set now, will do 3 concurrently max.
Josh: ensure autoscaler doesn't immediately spin new instances into the degraded AZ — set cluster-autoscaler to exclude zone temporarily.
Samira: adding a node-affinity taint instead: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-24 egress=degraded:NoSchedule` — prefer that first for quick stop.
Alex: good call. After 3 drains, switch LB weights using infra console: reduce 2b by 70% and increase dedicated by 30% then monitor 5m.
Marie: cost note — moving to Dedicated will increase spend ~18% for the burst window, but protects latency SLOs. We should log expected spend to incident ticket.
Priya: cloud ticket opened: CT-99821 — provider confirmed transient NAT gateway flapping in us-west-2b, working on mitigation.
Josh: until cloud fixes NAT, we should avoid scheduling new long-lived egress-heavy jobs in 2b. I'll update node labels to `egress-unsafe=true`.
Samira: application-level fallback: switch heavy-model routes to smaller fp16 quantized variants to reduce memory pressure — rollback if quality regression.
Alex: Marie, can you coordinate a quick eval with devex to confirm acceptability of fallback model?
Marie: on it. ETA 20m for smoke checks.
infra-bot: Alert: GPU pool util in 2b dropped 40% after drains, request latency increased 12% for overflowed routes.
Priya: seeing error rate normalize on drained nodes. Drains complete on 5 nodes.
Josh: setting cluster-autoscaler annotation `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-down-disabled=true` for the cluster during the incident to avoid churn.
Samira: adding a temp config change: `MODEL_BATCH_LIMIT=128 -> 64` across serving pods via rollout.
Alex: good. Everyone watch tracing and token-per-second metrics. If latency > 200ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows, we'll escalate to SEV1 and flip circuit to Dedicated-only.
Marie: cost snapshot added to ticket CT-99821: projected extra $3.5k over 24h if Dedicated stays at +30%.
Priya: provider says partial NAT replacement scheduled in 2h; they will reroute egress.
Josh: once NAT patch done, plan rollback: untaint nodes, allow scheduler, gradually shift LB weight back over 30m.
Samira: remind dev teams to pause large batch offline jobs in 2b until we confirm stability.
Alex: thanks team — ongoing updates here. If anyone notices regressions post-rollout, ping @oncall immediately. :thumbsup:
Marie: quick note — adding postmortem owner: Priya. Will sync tomorrow for RCA and cost optimization recommendations.
deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: none. No new deploys allowed to gpu pools in 2b until cleared.
Alex: closing loop for now — next update in 15.
